import numpy as np
# Baseline subtraction using points at 1100 and 1800 cm-1 (+/- 10 cm-1 average)
def process_curve(x, y):
    # Get baseline points
    mask_1100 = (x >= 1090) & (x <= 1110)
    mask_1800 = (x >= 1790) & (x <= 1810)
    
    if not np.any(mask_1100) or not np.any(mask_1800):
        return y
        
    base_y_1100 = np.mean(y[mask_1100])
    base_y_1800 = np.mean(y[mask_1800])
    
    # Linear baseline equation: y = mx + c
    m = (base_y_1800 - base_y_1100) / (1800 - 1100)
    c = base_y_1100 - m * 1100
    baseline = m * x + c
    
    # Subtract baseline
    y_sub = y - baseline
    
    # Normalize by G-band max (1550-1620 cm-1)
    mask_g = (x >= 1550) & (x <= 1620)
    if np.any(mask_g):
        g_max = np.max(y_sub[mask_g])
        if g_max > 0:
            y_norm = y_sub / g_max
        else:
            y_norm = y_sub
    else:
        y_norm = y_sub
        
    return y_norm
